author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.9.0 — Adds two independently-requested features: (1) per-vacuum low-battery auto-dock threshold, supplementing Wyze's own built-in low-battery return-and-resume behavior with a user-controlled, more conservative trigger point. (2) Dynamic dual poll interval -- fast (default 1 min) while any selected vacuum is actively cleaning, slow (default 15 min) the rest of the time, switching automatically on Cleaning <-> non-Cleaning transitions instead of a single fixed interval.
